# Are the IBANs in your payment list actually valid?

> Free bulk IBAN checker: validates a whole column of IBANs, finds wrong check digits (with the swapped-digit fix), wrong lengths, unknown countries, stray spaces, duplicates and blanks, and writes the list back cleaned. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
